🇧🇷 Português

AstroHealth é um PWA de monitoramento autônomo de saúde para astronautas em missões longas, com comunicação atrasada com a Terra.

O check-in diário registra sono, humor, estresse, exercício, pulso, pressão, temperatura e sintomas, além de CO2 e radiação. Os 14 primeiros dias formam a linha de base pessoal, e os últimos 3 dias são comparados a ela, gerando um semáforo para cinco sistemas. O app recomenda ações e gera um relatório para a equipe médica.

Funciona offline e roda em computador, tablet e celular. Protótipo com dados simulados.

🇺🇸 English

AstroHealth is a PWA for autonomous health monitoring of astronauts on long missions, with delayed communication with Earth.

A daily check-in records sleep, mood, stress, exercise, pulse, blood pressure, temperature and symptoms, plus CO2 and radiation. The first 14 days set a personal baseline, and the last 3 days are compared against it, producing a traffic light for five systems. The app recommends actions and generates a report for the medical team.

It works offline and runs on desktop, tablet and phone. Prototype with simulated data.
details:
What it does. AstroHealth is an offline-first Progressive Web App that helps astronauts on long-duration missions monitor their own health when Earth is minutes or hours away. A daily check-in records sleep, mood, stress, exercise, heart rate, blood pressure, temperature and symptoms, alongside cabin CO₂ and radiation. The first 14 days set a personal baseline, and the last 3 days are compared against it in standard deviations. The result is a traffic light (normal, attention, alert) for five systems: cardiovascular, musculoskeletal, immune, mental health and environment. The app then recommends actions and generates a compact report for ground medical teams.

Benefits and impact. It compares each person with themselves, works without internet, and runs on laptop, tablet and phone from one codebase. It supports crew autonomy for deep-space missions and can also serve remote communities, polar stations and other isolated sites.

Tools. HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript, inline SVG charts, browser local storage, web app manifest and service worker for installation and offline use. The current prototype uses simulated data.

Creativity and factors considered. Personal baselines instead of population averages, simple traffic-light decisions under stress, offline operation, and a clear disclaimer that it supports decisions and does not replace medical evaluation.

SI use. The code, slides and project text were produced with the help of Claude, an AI assistant by Anthropic, and reviewed by our team. [Adjust if your team edited or wrote parts yourselves.]
